title: Order illustrative mock-record design
description: Transcribed from docs/product-truth/mock-data/fern-and-fig/catalog.mock.json entities.Order.fields. All listed fields are present in the complete mock-record design. No production API, processor/auth request or runtime validation is implied; the canonical dataset remains unchanged.

status.description: enum: pending | paid | shipped | refunded — payment/lifecycle state (pending == open cart)

stage.description: enum: not-shipped | shipped | in-transit | delivered — fulfilment/delivery stage

carrier.description: string | null — shipping carrier once the parcel is dispatched, else null

tracking_number.description: string | null — carrier tracking code once dispatched, else null
